title: 이산화탄소 포집ㆍ수송ㆍ저장 및 활용에 관한 법률 시행규칙

rows.source_ko: 기후에너지환경부 (기후에너지신산업과), 044-203-3976
rows.text_en: Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment ( Climate, Energy and New Industries Division ), 044-203-3976

rows.source_ko: 과학기술정보통신부 (미래에너지환경기술과), 044-202-4675
rows.text_en: Ministry of Science and ICT ( Future Energy and Environment Technology Division ), 044-202-4675

rows.source_ko: 해양수산부 (기후환경국제전략팀), 051-773-6273,6271
rows.text_en: Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries ( Climate and Environment International Strategy Team ), 051-773-6273, 6271

rows.source_ko: 산업통상부 (자원안보정책과), 044-203-5245
rows.text_en: Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy ( Resource Security Policy Division ), 044-203-5245

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「이산화탄소 포집ㆍ수송ㆍ저장 및 활용에 관한 법률」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Capture, Transport, Storage and Use of Carbon Dioxide and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(이산화탄소 포집시설 설치ㆍ운영계획 신고서 등) 「이산화탄소 포집ㆍ수송ㆍ저장 및 활용에 관한 법률 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제8조제1항 및 같은 조 제4항에 따른 신고서 및 변경신고서는 별지 제1호서식의 이산화탄소 포집시설 설치ㆍ운영계획 (변경)신고서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Report on Plan for Installation and Operation of Carbon Dioxide Capture Facilities, etc.) The report and change report pursuant to Article 8(1) and (4) of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Capture, Transport, Storage and Use of Carbon Dioxide (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be in accordance with the Report on Plan for Installation and Operation of Carbon Dioxide Capture Facilities (Change) in Form No. 1 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(이산화탄소 수송사업 승인신청서) 영 제10조제2항에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 승인신청서”란 별지 제2호서식의 이산화탄소 수송사업 승인신청서를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Application for Approval of Carbon Dioxide Transport Business) In Article 10, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “application for approval prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” refers to the application for approval of a carbon dioxide transport business in Form No. 2 of the Appendix. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제4조(안전관리규정에 포함할 사항) 「이산화탄소 포집ㆍ수송ㆍ저장 및 활용에 관한 법률」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제9조제1항제3호에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 사항을 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Matters to be Included in Safety Management Regulations) The term “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” in Article 9(1), subparagraph 3 of the Act on the Capture, Transport, Storage and Use of Carbon Dioxide (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) refers to the matters in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제10조제1항에 따른 안전관리자의 직무ㆍ인원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the duties and personnel of safety managers pursuant to Article 10 , Paragraph 1 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 이산화탄소수송관의 작업 관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the work management of carbon dioxide transport pipelines

rows.source_ko: 3. 사업장 종사자의 교육ㆍ훈련에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the education and training of employees at the workplace

rows.source_ko: 제5조(안전관리자의 선임 신고 등) ① 법 제10조제1항에 따른 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 기간”이란 15일을 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Reporting of Appointment of Safety Manager, etc.) ① The “period prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Act refers to 15 days. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제10조제1항에 따라 안전관리자 선임 신고를 하려는 수송관설치운영자(법 제8조제1항 본문에 따른 승인을 받은 자를 말한다. 이하 같다)는 별지 제3호서식의 이산화탄소수송관 안전관리자 선임 신고서에 선임한 안전관리자의 국가기술자격증 사본을 첨부하여 기후에너지환경부장관에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② An operator of a transport pipeline who intends to report the appointment of a safety manager pursuant to Article 10 , Paragraph 1 of the Act ( referring to a person who has received approval under the main clause of Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Act ; hereinafter the same) shall submit the Report on the Appointment of a Carbon Dioxide Transport Pipeline Safety Manager in the Form No. 3 attached hereto to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment, attaching a copy of the national technical qualification certificate of the appointed safety manager. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제10조제2항에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 기간”이란 30일을 말한다. 다만, 수송관설치운영자가 그 기간 내에 다른 안전관리자를 선임할 수 없는 경우에는 기후에너지환경부장관이 30일의 범위에서 그 기간의 연장을 승인할 수 있다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ In Article 10 , Paragraph 2 of the Act , the term “period prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” refers to 30 days. However, if the pipeline installation and operation operator is unable to appoint another safety manager within such period, the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment may approve an extension of the period within the scope of 30 days. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제6조(안전검사신청서) 영 제14조제1항에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 안전검사신청서”란 별지 제4호서식의 이산화탄소수송관 안전검사신청서를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Application for Safety Inspection) In Article 14, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “application for safety inspection prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment”refers to the application for safety inspection of carbon dioxide transport pipes in Form No. 4 of the Appendix . <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제7조(안전검사 유효기간 연장신청서) 영 제15조제2항에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 안전검사 유효기간 연장신청서”란 별지 제5호서식의 이산화탄소수송관 안전검사 유효기간 연장신청서를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Application for Extension of Safety Inspection Validity Period) In Article 15, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “Application for Extension of Safety Inspection Validity Period prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” refers to the Application for Extension of the Safety Inspection Validity Period for Carbon Dioxide Transport Pipelines in Form No. 5 of the Appendix . <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제8조(탐사승인신청서 등) ① 영 제16조제1항에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 탐사승인신청서”란 별지 제6호서식의 저장소 탐사승인신청서를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Application for Approval of Exploration, etc.) ① In Article 16 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “application for approval of exploration prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment”refers to the application for approval of exploration of a storage facility in Form No. 6 of the Appendix . <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제16조제5항에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 탐사승인서”란 별지 제7호서식의 저장소 탐사승인서를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② In Article 16 , Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “exploration approval certificate prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” refers to the storage facility exploration approval certificate in Form No. 7 of the Appendix . <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제9조(탐사실적의 제출 등) ① 영 제18조제1항에 따른 탐사권자는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함된 탐사실적 보고서를 기후에너지환경부장관에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Submission of Exploration Results, etc.) ① An exploration right holder pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit an exploration results report containing the matters of each of the following subparagraphs to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 탐사한 지역의 위치 및 면적
rows.text_en: 1. Location and area of ​​the surveyed region

rows.source_ko: 2. 시추공(試錐孔) 개수 및 위치(시추를 한 경우로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Number and location of boreholes (limited to cases where drilling has been performed)

rows.source_ko: 3. 도출된 저장후보지 위치 및 저장용량
rows.text_en: 3. Derived Candidate Storage Locations and Storage Capacity

rows.source_ko: 4. 탐사 및 시추 관련 지질학적 데이터
rows.text_en: 4. Geological data related to exploration and drilling

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제18조제3항에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 탐사실적 제출기간 연장신청서”란 별지 제8호서식의 저장소 탐사실적 제출기간 연장신청서를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② In Article 18, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “application for extension of the submission period for exploration results prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” refers to the application for extension of the submission period for reservoir exploration results in Form No. 8 of the Appendix . <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제10조(원상복구 완료 승인신청서) 영 제25조제5항에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 승인신청서”란 별지 제9호서식의 저장소 원상복구 완료 승인신청서를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Application for Approval of Completion of Restoration to Original Condition) In Article 25 , Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree , the term “application for approval prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment”refers to the Application for Approval of Completion of Restoration to Original Condition of a Storage Facility in Form No. 9 of the Appendix . <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제11조(저장사업 허가신청서 등) 영 제26조제1항 및 같은 조 제3항에 따른 저장사업 허가신청서 및 저장사업 변경허가신청서는 별지 제10호서식의 저장사업 허가ㆍ변경허가 신청서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Application for Storage Business Permit, etc.) The application for a storage business permit and the application for a storage business change permit pursuant to Article 26 , Paragraph 1 and Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the application for a storage business permit or change permit in Form No. 10 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제12조(저장소 사용신고서) 영 제28조에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 저장소 사용신고서”란 별지 제11호서식의 저장소 사용신고서를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Notification of Use of Storage Facility) In Article 28 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “notification of use of storage facility prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” refers to the notification of use of storage facility in Form No. 11 of the Appendix. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제13조(저장사업자 지위승계 신고서 등) ① 영 제29조제1항에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 지위 승계신고서”란 별지 제12호서식의 저장사업자 지위 승계신고서를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Report on Succession of Status of Storage Business Operator, etc.) ① In Article 29 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree , the term “report on succession of status prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment”refers to the report on succession of status of a storage business operator in Annex 12. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제20조제3항에 따라 저장사업자의 상속인이 저장사업자의 지위를 승계하려는 경우에는 제1항에 따른 저장사업자 지위 승계신고서에 상속인임을 증명하는 서류를 첨부하여 기후에너지환경부장관에게 제출해야 한다. 이 경우 행정정보의 공동이용에 대해서는 영 제29조제2항을 준용한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② In accordance with Article 20, Paragraph 3 of the Act , if an heir of a storage business operator intends to succeed to the status of a storage business operator, he/she shall submit a report on the succession of the storage business operator status under Paragraph 1 to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment, attaching documents proving his/her status. In this case, Article 29, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall apply mutatis mutandis to the joint use of administrative information . < Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제14조(저장사업 개시신고서) 영 제30조에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 저장사업 개시신고서”란 별지 제13호서식의 저장사업 개시신고서를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Notice of Commencement of Storage Business) In Article 30 of the Enforcement Decree , the term “notice of commencement of storage business prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” refers to the notice of commencement of storage business in Form No. 13 of the Appendix. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제15조(저장사업 휴업ㆍ폐업 허가신청서) 영 제31조제1항 각 호 외의 부분에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 허가신청서”란 별지 제14호서식의 저장사업 휴업ㆍ폐업 허가신청서를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Application for Permission for Suspension or Closure of Storage Business) In the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 31 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “application for permission prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment”refers to the application for permission for suspension or closure of a storage business in Form No. 14 of the Appendix . <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제16조(저장사업자에 대한 행정처분기준) 법 제23조제2항에 따른 위반행위별 행정처분 기준은 별표 1과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Standards for Administrative Dispositions against Storage Business Operators) The standards for administrative dispositions by violation pursuant to Article 23, Paragraph 2 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 1 .

rows.source_ko: 제17조(모니터링계획 승인신청서) 영 제33조제3항에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 승인신청서”란 별지 제15호서식의 저장소 모니터링계획 승인신청서를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Application for Approval of Monitoring Plan) In Article 33, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “application for approval prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” refers to the application for approval of a storage facility monitoring plan in Form No. 15 of the Appendix. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제18조(저장소 운영 일시 중단 승인신청서) 영 제36조제5항에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 일시 중단 승인신청서”란 별지 제16호서식의 저장소 일시 중단 승인신청서를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 18 (Application for Approval of Temporary Suspension of Storage Facility Operation) In Article 36 , Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree , the term “application for approval of temporary suspension prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment”refers to the application for approval of temporary suspension of a storage facility in Form No. 16 of the Appendix . <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제19조(집적화단지 지정신청서) 영 제39조제2항에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 지정신청서”란 별지 제17호서식의 이산화탄소 포집ㆍ저장ㆍ활용 집적화단지 지정신청서를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 19 (Application for Designation of Integrated Complex) In Article 39, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “application for designation prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment”refers to the application for designation of a Carbon Capture, Storage, and Utilization Integrated Complex in Form No. 17 of the Appendix . <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제20조(집적화단지 지정해제신청서) 영 제42조제2항 각 호 외의 부분에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 지정해제신청서”란 별지 제18호서식의 이산화탄소 포집ㆍ저장ㆍ활용 집적화단지 지정해제신청서를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Application for De-designation of Integrated Complex) In the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 42, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “application for de-designation prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” refers to the application for de-designation of a Carbon Capture, Storage, and Utilization Integrated Complex in Form No. 18 of the Appendix. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제21조(전문인력 양성기관 지정신청서) 영 제58조제2항 각 호 외의 부분에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 지정신청서”란 별지 제19호서식의 전문인력 양성기관 지정신청서를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 21 (Application for Designation of Professional Training Institution) In the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 58, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “application for designation prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment” refers to the application for designation of a professional training institution in Form No. 19 of the Appendix. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제22조(표준화사업 추진 전문기관 지정신청서) 영 제59조제2항에서 “기후에너지환경부령으로 정하는 지정신청서”란 별지 제20호서식의 표준화사업 추진 전문기관 지정신청서를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 22 (Application for Designation of Specialized Agency for Standardization Projects) In Article 59, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “application for designation prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment”refers to the application for designation of a specialized agency for standardization projects in Annex 20. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <산업통상자원부령 제597호, 2025. 2. 6.>
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy Decree No. 597, Feb. 6, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 이 규칙은 2025년 2월 7일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: This rule shall take effect on February 7, 2025.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <기후에너지환경부령 제1호, 2025. 10. 1.> (기후에너지환경부와 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment Decree No. 1, Oct. 1, 2025> (Enforcement Rule on the Organization of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and its Affiliated Agencies)

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 부칙 제6조에 따라 개정되는 부령 중 이 규칙 시행 전에 공포되었으나 시행일이 도래하지 아니한 부령을 개정한 부분은 각각 해당 부령의 시행일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, among the Ministerial Ordinances amended pursuant to Article 6 of the Addenda, the parts amending Ministerial Ordinances that were promulgated prior to the enforcement of this Rule but whose effective date has not yet arrived shall enter into force on the respective effective dates of those Ordinances.

rows.source_ko: 제2조 부터 제5조까지 생략
rows.text_en: Articles 2  through 5 omitted

rows.text_en: Article 6 (Amendment of Other Laws)  ① through <53> Omitted

rows.source_ko: <54> 이산화탄소 포집ㆍ수송ㆍ저장 및 활용에 관한 법률 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: <54> The Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Capture, Transport, Storage and Utilization of Carbon Dioxide are partially amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제3조, 제4조 각 호 외의 부분, 제5조제1항, 같은 조 제3항 본문, 제6조, 제7조, 제8조제1항ㆍ제2항, 제9조제2항, 제10조, 제12조, 제13조제1항, 제14조, 제15조 및 제17조부터 제22조까지 중 “산업통상자원부령”을 각각 “기후에너지환경부령”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 3, the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 4, Article 5 Paragraph 1, the main text of Paragraph 3 of the same Article, Article 6, Article 7, Article 8 Paragraphs 1 and 2, Article 9 Paragraph 2, Article 10, Article 12, Article 13 Paragraph 1, Article 14, Article 15, and Articles 17 through 22, “Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy” shall be replaced with “Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment.”

rows.source_ko: 제5조제2항, 같은 조 제3항 단서, 제9조제1항 각 호 외의 부분 및 제13조제2항 전단 중 “산업통상자원부장관”을 각각 “기후에너지환경부장관”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 5, Paragraph 2, the proviso to Paragraph 3 of the same article, the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 9, Paragraph 1, and the first part of Article 13, Paragraph 2, “Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy” shall be changed to “Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment”.

rows.source_ko: 별지 제1호서식부터 별지 제18호서식까지 중 “산업통상자원부장관”을 각각 “기후에너지환경부장관”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Forms No. 1 through No. 18 of the Attached Forms, “Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy” shall be changed to “Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment”.

rows.source_ko: 별지 제17호서식의 처리절차란 및 별지 제18호서식의 처리절차란 중 “산업통상자원부”를 각각 “기후에너지환경부”로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the processing procedure section of Form No. 17 and Form No. 18, “Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy” shall be changed to “Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment”.
